plants.name: Tulipa gesneriana
plants.description: A bulbous perennial with cup-shaped flowers atop sturdy stems and broad blue-green leaves. Thousands of cultivars exist, including single, double, fringed, and parrot types. Mid to late April is peak bloom in the Netherlands, northern Europe, and temperate North America.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid spring (April to May in the Northern Hemisphere)
plants.location: Netherlands, Northern Europe, Northeastern North America, cultivated worldwide in temperate zones
plants.funFact: During 17th-century Dutch 'Tulip Mania', single bulbs sold for more than the price of a house in Amsterdam.

plants.name: Prunus serrulata
plants.description: A deciduous ornamental tree covered in clouds of ruffled blossoms before or as the leaves emerge. Late-blooming cultivars such as 'Kanzan' flower in mid to late April in many temperate regions, while northern Japan's Tohoku and Hokkaido regions see peak sakura around this time.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early to mid spring (late March to late April depending on latitude and cultivar)
plants.location: Japan (Tohoku and Hokkaido), Eastern United States, Pacific Northwest, Europe
plants.funFact: The Japanese custom of hanami, or flower viewing, has been celebrated for over a thousand years, and the sakura front moves northward across Japan at roughly 2 km per hour.

plants.name: Cercis canadensis
plants.description: A small deciduous tree whose clusters of pea-like magenta-pink flowers sprout directly from bare branches and even the trunk, followed by heart-shaped leaves. It is a favorite early food source for native bees.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early to mid spring (late March to late April)
plants.location: Eastern and Central North America, from Ontario south to Mexico
plants.funFact: Redbud flowers are edible and have a mild, tangy flavor; they are sometimes added to salads or fried as fritters.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: A tropical to subtropical tree with fern-like foliage that bears dense panicles of trumpet-shaped lavender-blue flowers. In the Southern Hemisphere it blooms in spring, but in parts of the tropics and northern subtropics such as Mexico and parts of Florida, early blooms appear in April to May, while other regions have blooms from earlier months lingering into autumn.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring to early summer in the Northern Hemisphere subtropics (April to June); October to December in the Southern Hemisphere
plants.location: Native to South America; widely planted in Mexico, Southern California, Florida, Africa, and Australia
plants.funFact: In Pretoria, South Africa, so many jacarandas line the streets that the city is nicknamed 'Jacaranda City', and falling flowers create purple carpets on the pavement.
